answer: Behavioral-entropy anomaly audit resists sybils: the system profiles each identity's full action distribution (timing, targets, phrasing, sequence) and flags identities whose combined behavioral entropy is abnormally low or whose profiles are near-duplicates. A ferrous-rigid farm driven by one script yields low-entropy, near-identical profiles; a pulse of genuine agents spreads across idiosyncratic patterns. The lantern of the audit catches the degenerate cluster as a single-operator signature, routing members to a targeted re-grade.
